text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Algerian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Parliamentary vote passing government programme shows Prime Minister Ouyahia has proved "he can decide everything, do everything even against the will of those who seem to give weight to his majority".
- Bomb wounds three people in western city of Oran.
- Vote of confidence divided government coalition and showed up contradictions within it.
- Armed group kills family of seven and two other motorists at fake roadblock near Mascara. Security forces kill two "terrorists" in Blida province.
- Vote for government programme by coalition partners was above all political; they did not want to interrupt implementation of institutions ahead of local elections.
